defects.what: The bronze marker plaque in the lower middle carries five lines of large pseudo-letters (RECVINE DENI ...), right where the narration reads it aloud.
The plaque in the lower left is covered in rows of East Asian-looking pseudo-glyphs under a star emblem.
Two jaguars are drawn, one overlapping the other in the alley, where the script has a single jaguar appearing.
The whole gold coin in the hand shows a big letter D and pseudo-lettering around its rim, filling the close-up.
A small United States flag flies on the fort tower at the top left, in a scene at Fort San Diego, Acapulco.
Gold pseudo-cursive titles on the stacked book spines (left) and scribbled pseudo-text on the open pages and papers.
The sheet being signed carries several lines of small pseudo-text.
The paper under the quill shows three lines of pseudo-cursive scribbles in the foreground.
The boy in the foreground wears an orange shirt with pseudo-letters (LGT-like) on the back.
Scattered pseudo-numerals and glyphs on the chart and on the compass dial.
The young man with the red headband has reddish-brown hair with no topknot and a black hoodie, so he does not read as Indio.
Seen from behind, the man in the red headband has short brown hair and no topknot.
